boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain St. Mary's College of Maryland
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations in the Lexington Park area with currently published late service hours.

cards.subtitle: Lexington Park, MD
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or restaurant before midnight; confirm holiday changes and arrange transportation before leaving the St. Mary’s City campus.

cards.source_title: Wendy’s — 21589 Great Mills Rd, Lexington Park
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed 8:00 AM–12:00 AM daily; holiday hours may vary.
